The petitioner has filed reply affidavit to the counter affidavit and in particular referred to paragraph No.3 of the counter affidavit in which the petitioners specifically contend that the petitioners had sent a complaint dated 16.08.2021 to the 3rd respondent through registered post with acknowledgment due and the said postal receipt had also been filed as a material document in support of the affidavit filed in the present writ petition.

Taking into consideration the above referred facts and circumstances, and the averments made in para 3 of the counter affidavit filed by respondent No.3 (referred to and extracted above) the writ petition is disposed of directing the petitioners to make a fresh representation to the 3rd and 4th respondents with all the relevant documents, within a period of two (02) weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order, explaining the petitioners' grievance as put-forth in their complaint dated 16.08.2021, which pertains to acquisition of assigned land from landless poor in Sy.Nos.252 (122-00), 278(66-00), 361(142-00) of Siddapur Village, Kothur Mandal, Rangareddy District and for payment of compensation to the actual possessors irrespective of patta rights.

The respondent Nos.3 and 4, soon after receipt of the said representation from the petitioners, are directed to consider the said petitioners' representation, in accordance to law, and initiate appropriate action,
within a period of three (03) weeks thereafter.
However, there shall be no order as to costs.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Writ Petition, shall stand closed.

2. The petitioners approached the Court seeking the prayer as follows:
"To issue a writ, order or direction more particularly one in the nature of writ of mandamus:
a. To direct the Vigilance Officer & Enforcement Officer, the 3rd respondent herein,
to cause preliminary enquiry on our complaint dated 16.08.2021;
b. To direct the District Collector, Ranga Reddy, 4th respondent herein, to conduct detailed enquiry with regard to payment of compensation to illegal and in-eligible people with regard to acquisition of land in Sy.No.252, 278 and 361 total an extent of Ac.240-16 Gts with specific regard to role of respondent No.8 and 9;
c. To direct District Collector, Ranga Reddy, 4th respondent herein, to provide copy of proceedings of Award passed under Act 30 of 2013 or any other proceeding through which said lands have been taken over by Government from us and others;
d.
To grant any other relief or reliefs in the interest of justice."
